name: LENFOR
name_zh: 深圳市蓝方技术有限公司
summary: LENFOR is the brand of Shenzhen Lanfang Technology Co., Ltd., a motor-control and precision-transmission developer within Mannst. Its current component portfolio comprises parallel and adaptive electric grippers, rotary grippers, long-stroke grippers, miniature electric cylinders, electric slides and a five-finger anthropomorphic hand. The company’s official address is in Longgang District, Shenzhen.
